# toAccessibilityMode

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`AccessibilityModeInput`](accessibility-mode-input.md) to the [`AccessibilityMode`](accessibility-mode.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toAccessibilityMode(input: AccessibilityModeToken | AccessibilityMode): AccessibilityMode
```
